_about: Retired works and where they now live. Ian, 2026-09-24: where a work is in the library twice, Stiven's copy wins and ours is retired; every link to ours must still land.
Retired = removed from the English Editions catalogue (v1/mo/index.json) and the title index; the old R2 files (v1/mo/<slug>.json, v1/works/<slug>/) stay in place.

pages: old reader page -> [new page, anchor id on the new copy]; anchors: old division id (#q-33, #article-4, #lords-day-2) -> the same. Anchors were read off the new copy as the live reader renders it (2026-09-24). Where no anchors table is given, the old ids follow the page numbers (page 33 = Q. 33 / Article 33 / Chapter 33) and `legacy` names their prefix.
legacy: the division id prefix the old per-work page used (/the-faith-received/westminster-shorter/#q-33).
search: extra words the title index should match for the new copy (the old name).
research: the Research panel's Scripture list for the new copy also shows the old copy's citations (page/faith-port-read-research-overlay.js).
Consumers: assets/js/lib/faith-work-forwards.js (generated block; run node scripts/build-work-forwards.mjs after editing), scripts/build-works-title-index.mjs, scripts/retire-works.mjs.
